description: A course completed by the user.

main.description: Record representing a single completed course.

role.description: The user's role in the course. Absent means the user took it. A taught course renders under Teaching.

institution.description: Institution or platform offering the course.

institutionDid.description: DID of the institution or platform's ATproto account, if one exists.

entityRef.description: Portable, app-neutral identifier for the institution or platform the user selected from a resolver dropdown: a Wikidata Q-ID URI (http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q...), a ROR URI, or an LEI URI. Enables deterministic resolution to a canonical entity even before the organization claims an ATproto account. Absent for free-text entries.

agentRef.description: The institution or platform offering the course, as a single nested reference mirroring the flat institution / institutionDid / entityRef fields. Additive dual-write: the flat fields remain the source of truth for existing consumers.

education.description: AT-URI of the id.sifa.profile.education record the course was part of, such as a course within a degree. A plain at-uri rather than a strongRef so the link tracks the live education record across edits.

credential.description: AT-URI of the associated id.sifa.profile.certification record (the credential earned from this course), if applicable. A plain at-uri rather than a strongRef so the link tracks the live certification across edits.

completedAt.description: Date the course was completed, in YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit if unknown. Applies to a course the user took.

startedAt.description: When the user started teaching the course, in YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format. Applies to a taught or assisted course.

endedAt.description: When the user last taught the course, in YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit if still teaching it.

position.description: AT-URI of the id.sifa.profile.position record the course was part of: taught under it, or taken as part of the job. A plain at-uri rather than a strongRef so the link tracks the live position across edits.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.
